title: fix(studio): an item just added to a dashboard list property is held until it is filled in, not autosaved and refused (#27459)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 界面支柱里，仪表盘属性面板的列表（「全局筛选」、页眉「操作按钮」）点「Add item」后，新项在必填项填好之前不再自动保存草稿；画布上方出现一行中性提示，点名列表、第几项和还缺的输入（如 “Field on item #1 of “Global Filters” needs a value”），带「Show me」打开仪表盘属性并定位到该列表；填好后下一次自动保存把期间所有改动一起发出。
- 为什么改：以前空项立刻被 PUT 成 `globalFilters[N] = {}`，草稿门 422；之后每次保存都带着这个空项继续 422，所以在这之后改的 Label 等都丢了（重载后消失）。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端的拦截判定，判定问 spec 自己的 `DashboardSchema`，不另存必填清单；某项只在「所有报错都落在它还没填的输入上」时才拦，填了错值的照常发送并显示红色拒绝条。最坏情况是多拦一次（提示行 + Show me 可解）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.ts`（`listItemHeldInput` / `heldListItem` / `dashboardHeldEdit`）、`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`（`StudioHeldNotice` 泛型化与界面支柱的 Show me 分支）、`InterfacesPillar.heldListItem-27459.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.heldListItem-27459.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/InterfacesPillar.heldListItem-27459.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件 19 条全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27459

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

**The hold.** The Interfaces pillar's leaf autosave already holds a dashboard whose new widget still waits for its dataset or measures (`dashboardHeldEdit`, judged by the spec's `DashboardWidgetSchema`). It now also holds a dashboard with an item of one of its own list properties that is merely unfinished:

- `listItemHeldInput(body, schema, skip)` asks the leaf's spec schema (`DashboardSchema` here) of the body the autosave would send. Each issue is placed on the item of the outermost list its path enters. An item is held only when every issue placed on it names an input directly below it that the item leaves unset (absent, or a text cleared to an empty string). An issue on the item itself, or on an input holding a value, makes it finished but wrong: it is sent, and the refusal it draws shows as before. The `widgets` list is skipped, so the widget rule keeps its own hold and is asked first.
- No required-input list lives in the Studio: the spec decides what an item needs.
- The held line names the input and the list the way the properties panel shows them (the form row's own label, translated, or its prettified key) and the item by the `#n` its row shows. One new clause, `engine.studio.held.listItemNeedsInput` (en, zh): the existing widget, step, action and field clauses name no list item.
- `StudioHeld` gains a `Target` type parameter (default `MetadataSelection`, so the other pillars are unchanged) and an optional `input`. A list item's target is `null`, the leaf's own properties, which no selection opens. Its "Show me" is always offered and goes through the pillar's existing `showLeafRefusal` (clears the selection, opens the properties slot, expands a collapsed inspector, focuses the list by its label).
- `prettify` moves from `SchemaForm.tsx` to `field-source-label.ts` as `prettifyFieldName` (no runtime imports there), so the held line can name a row exactly as `SchemaForm` does without importing the form component. `SchemaForm` imports it under its old local name; nothing else changes there.

The Publish refusal and the surface's leave guard read the same reported clause (`useHeldEditReport`), unchanged.

## Tests

- New `metadataError.heldListItem-27459.test.ts` (15 cases). Every held case is paired with the spec's verdict on the same dashboard (it refuses exactly the unset inputs): Global Filters' new item (the repeater's all-`undefined` row, and the stored `{}` the card saw), header Actions' new item (held for Label, then for Action URL), an Action URL cleared to blank, zh-CN naming, and the widget rule asked first. Controls: a Field filled is accepted and not held; a Field cleared to blank is one the spec takes, so not held; a header action refused for the URL it holds is sent; an item with an unset Field and a wrong `type` is sent; a list holding a non-item value is sent; a dashboard the spec accepts holds nothing.
- New `InterfacesPillar.heldListItem-27459.test.tsx` (4 cases), the real `DashboardDefaultInspector` over a recording metadata client: the card's path (Filters → Global Filters → Add item, then a Label edit) sends no PUT past the debounce, shows no red strip, and names the Field; "Show me" focuses a control in the Global Filters row; filling the Field sends one save carrying the item and the Label edit kept meanwhile, which `DashboardSchema` accepts, and clears the line; control: a Label edit alone saves at once.

Readings below are on the final head `7ff9cb5c` (this branch merged with `origin/main`) unless a line says otherwise.

## Acceptance notes

- **The report half of the card's step 7 is not in this PR.** The card names the same class on a report's Properties panel (Order and joined-blocks "Add item", a chart type chosen before its axes). This PR holds the dashboard path the card's title, reproduction and clause name (`studio-authoring.dashboard-widget-and-filter-types` acceptance[4]). `listItemHeldInput` takes the schema as an argument, so the report's list items need only `ReportSchema` and the report form at the pillar's leaf gate; a chart type set before its axes is not a list item and needs its own rule. Named in the report for the seat to carry as a follow-up card before this one closes.
- **Header Actions: the spec judges an action's URL only once the action has its label.** An action with a bad URL and no label is therefore held for its label first, and its URL refusal shows after the label is given. That is the spec's issue order, not a second validator.
- **"Show me" does not expand a collapsed form section.** The Filters section of the dashboard form is collapsed by default; when the author has collapsed it again, "Show me" opens the dashboard properties but finds no Global Filters label to focus. The line still names the list.
- A Field cleared to an empty string is accepted by the installed spec (`GlobalFilterSchema.field` is a plain string), so it is sent, not held: the hold is never stricter than the contract.
